claim: A unit bearing is the int16 binary angle at [E0+0x64c] (65536 = 360 degrees; the bearing getter returns degrees in [0, 360)): 0 = +z, 90 = +x, clockwise seen from above, the same convention as the camera yaw (atan2(fx, fz)). Ordered 90, 270, 0 and 180: the front centre lies along (sin b, cos b) from the centre every time
